integrity: The factorization, resultant, transition law, square-class identities, and divisor arithmetic are checked by an exact symbolic verifier. Irreducibility additionally uses an explicit biquadratic square-class argument. The proof relies on the initiating paper for the established analytic classification of the 96 nodes, 64 cusps, and residual boundary smoothness.
scientific_limitations: The decomposition is proved over C and concerns only the residual I1-discriminant on the blown-up base. No claim is made about the smallest field of definition of the two factors. The local node/cusp types and boundary smoothness are taken from the initiating paper and the new contribution refines their distribution among the two components.
title: The residual discriminant splits into two genus-nine curves
